text: Elara tightened her grip on the cold steel railing of the mag-lev train as it hummed its way across the continent toward the Neo-Western Frontier. It was 2147, and she was leaving behind the suffocating regulations of her traditional life in a crowded, subterranean sector of Old London for the promise of autonomy and discovery in the open-air colonies of Mars. She clutched her small, battered data-slate that contained all her digital identity and credits, her heart racing with both fear and excitement. Tell me what a book is primarily made of.
